title: Research sprint goal: The whole suite fits its seconds ceiling under host load without the ceiling changing
goal: The sprint goal's questions the kb answers weakly or not at all are answered with the live docs and written as kb facts or gap entries through the kb skills, so each committed item can name the knowledge it needs: what os.getloadavg returns on macOS and what its 1, 5 and 15 minute averages count (weak: os.getloadavg is not in the kb), and what bounds the wall time of a pytest-xdist --dist loadscope run on a loaded host (the pack's good carried a check: line, since no cited line states the bound). Good in the kb and not researched: how loadscope groups tests, how -n auto picks the worker count, how pytest --collect-only counts a -k selection. Tested rows for kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv are a code-lane path (_tools/kblane.py): a story finished with them lands through backlog.py land ID --wait-merge SECONDS, not done --commit.
